Court No. - 44
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 11659 of 2025
Petitioner :- Mukesh Kumar Sharma
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 5 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Arpit Singh,Jai Raj Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Harvir Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for the following reliefs:-
"(i) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the Respondent nos. 2 and 3 to ensure the speedy fair and impartial investigation within stipulated period or time in First Information Report dated 26.04.2024 registered as Mukesh Kumar Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191855079/
1 Case Crime No. 74 of 2024, under Section 420 IPC, Police Station Lohamandi,
District Agra and further to take immediate strict action against the Respondent Nos.
4 to 6.
(ii) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the Respondent Nos. 2 and 3 to taken immediate strict action against the Respondent Nos. 4 to 6.

entities.text: Mukesh Kumar Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iii) To issue any other order or direction, which the Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.
(iv) To award the cost of the petition to this petitioner"

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is the first informant in the present case and he had lodged the F.I.R. against the Respondent Nos. 4 to 6 on 26.04.2024,
however, the police is not investigating the case in fair and impartial manner.
4.
In view of the above, the petitioner may move an application before the respondent no.2- Commissioner of Police, Agra, highlighting his grievance and seeking fair and impartial investigation.
If such an application is moved by the petitioner, respondent no.2- Commissioner of Police, Agra shall ensure fair, impartial and expeditious investigation in the present case.
5. With the aforesaid order, the present writ petition stands disposed of.
